#!/usr/bin/env python3
import json
import socket
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer

INVENTORY = [
    {"id": 1, "sku": "WRD-001", "name": "Widget", "qty": 120},
    {"id": 2, "sku": "GDT-002", "name": "Gadget", "qty": 45},
    {"id": 3, "sku": "GZM-003", "name": "Gizmo", "qty": 78},
]

HOSTNAME = socket.gethostname()

class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def _json(self, payload, status=200):
        body = json.dumps(payload).encode()
        self.send_response(status)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path == "/healthz":
            self._json({"status": "ok", "backend": HOSTNAME})
        elif self.path == "/inventory":
            self._json({"backend": HOSTNAME, "items": INVENTORY})
        elif self.path == "/":
            self._json({"service": "inventory-app", "backend": HOSTNAME})
        else:
            self._json({"error": "not found"}, status=404)

    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        pass

if __name__ == "__main__":
    ThreadingHTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", 8080), Handler).serve_forever()
